title: docs: Audit and correct protocol implementation status across documentation
body:
Documentation contained outdated protocol counts (109 vs actual 123) and package counts (12 vs actual 10), with no visibility into implementation status.

## Changes

**Protocol Count Corrections**
- Updated from 109 to 123 across all reference docs (found 14 additional AI/integration schemas)
- Corrected AI protocol count: 9 → 12 (added feedback-loop, devops-agent)

**Package Inventory Correction**  
- Removed non-existent packages (@objectstack/ai-bridge, @objectstack/types)
- Corrected total: 12 → 10 packages (7 core + 3 plugins)

**Package Documentation Enhancements**
- Added implementation details for each package with actual exported APIs
- Marked production-ready vs reference implementations
- Updated dependency graph to reflect actual structure
- Added feature matrices showing capability gaps (e.g., memory driver: CRUD ✅, transactions ❌)

**New Implementation Status Matrix** (`implementation-status.mdx`)
- Protocol-by-package implementation coverage (26 fully implemented, 6 partial, 91 spec-only)
- Production readiness indicators per functional area
- REST endpoint inventory with implementation status
- Field type support matrix
- Roadmap phases mapped to actual completion

**Cross-Reference Updates**
- Added navigation cards linking to new status matrix
- Inserted callouts directing users to implementation status before diving into protocols

## Coverage Statistics

| Category | Fully Implemented | Partial | Not Implemented |
|----------|-------------------|---------|-----------------|
| Core Infrastructure | 8/9 | 1/9 | 0/9 |
| Data Layer | 6/16 | 3/16 | 7/16 |
| API Layer | 10/13 | 1/13 | 2/13 |
| System Services | 8/39 | 1/39 | 30/39 |
| All Others | 0/46 | 0/46 | 46/46 |

Users can now quickly determine which protocols are production-ready vs design artifacts.
